title: Manage your marketing preferences for the NSW Seniors Card program
summary: Manage how you receive information and offers related to your NSW Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card.
intro:
When you apply for a NSW Seniors Card or Senior Savers Card, you can choose to receive the Seniors Card monthly newsletter, as well as information on exclusive Seniors Card discounts and offers.

You can receive information by both email and mail, or email only.

You can stop receiving communications or update your marketing preferences online, by email or by phone.
what_you_need: The service 'Seniors/Senior Savers Card' added to your MyServiceNSW Account (if you have not already)
If updating by email or phone: Your name and contact details

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account.
Add the service ‘Seniors/Senior Savers Card’ to your MyServiceNSW Account (if you have not already).
Follow the prompts to update your marketing preferences.

faqs.q: How can I update my marketing preferences?
faqs.a: You can update your marketing preferences online, by email, or by phone.

faqs.q: What information can I receive about my Seniors Card?
faqs.a: You can receive the Seniors Card monthly newsletter and information on exclusive Seniors Card discounts and offers.

faqs.q: What methods can I use to receive Seniors Card information?
faqs.a: You can receive information by both email and mail, or email only.
